transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because I keep planning my days around not having to drive over those high bridges. And, uh... if I can't find a way around it, I just white-knuckle it the whole way across. That's about it, really.
Is it just driving over high bridges that causes you anxiety, or are there other driving situations that also make you feel this way?

No, it's pretty much just the bridges. I mean... I know those big ones over the bay are built fine. Folks drive 'em every day. But, uh... when I get near one, my mind just sort of acts like the car could go right over the side. 

Regular driving is fine, though. Just the bridges.
Do you experience anxiety or discomfort in other situations that involve heights, like being near a balcony or at the top of a tall building?
No, not really. Balconies and buildings are fine. It's... just the bridges.
Is it the height of the bridges that scares you, or is it more the fact that you're driving over them?
I'm not really sure. I just... I don't like being on them. I don't know if it's the height or the driving part. It's just being on the bridge itself that gets to me.
Would you feel anxious if you were a passenger on a bus driving over one of these high bridges?
I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't taken a bus in a long time. So, I couldn't say for sure.
Would you feel anxious if you were walking on one of these high bridges?
I... I don't know. I don't walk on them. I avoid them, so... I couldn't really tell you.
Would your anxiety about the bridge be less if someone else was driving you over it?
I don't think so. But... I really couldn't tell you. I just stay away from them altogether, so it hasn't really come up. It doesn't seem to matter who has the wheel.
Would you feel anxious if you were standing on a high bridge, but not driving?
I... I don't know. Like I said, I just don't go near them. So I haven't tried standing on one. I just stay away.
Do you think your anxiety about bridges would decrease if you felt completely safe and in control while driving on them?
I... I really couldn't say. It's just hard to picture. Like I've been saying, I just don't drive on them, so... I don't know how I'd feel.
Would your anxiety about the bridge be less if you were driving over it in a vehicle that you felt was extremely safe and stable?
I don't think the car matters. I just... I don't know. Like I said, I avoid them. I can't really guess how I'd feel in a different car.
Would you feel anxious if you were standing on a solid, wide observation deck of a high bridge, with no risk of falling?
I... I'm not sure. I just stay away from bridges altogether. I don't really know how I'd feel on an observation deck because I wouldn't put myself in that situation.
Would you feel anxious if you were a passenger in a car being driven by someone else over one of these high bridges?
I... I really don't think that would change anything. It's the bridge itself. I just... I wouldn't do it.
Would you feel anxious if you were on a high bridge, but not in a vehicle, such as on a pedestrian path?
I don't know... I wouldn't be walking on one either. I just... I don't go on them.
Would you feel anxious if you were on a train going over a high bridge?
I... I don't really ride trains. But if it has to go over a high bridge... I just wouldn't buy a ticket. It's all the same to me. I just avoid them.
Would you feel anxious if you were on a high bridge, but not driving, such as on a bike or on foot?
I... I think I just mentioned the walking part. But yeah, walking, biking... it doesn't make a difference. I just wouldn't be up there.
Would you feel anxious if you were on a high bridge, but in a situation where you weren't moving at all, such as being stopped or parked on the bridge?
I just... I wouldn't be parked on one. If I'm not on the bridge, I can't be stopped on it. I don't know what else to tell you.
Would you feel anxious if you were on a high bridge, but not in control of the vehicle, such as on a tour bus with a professional driver?
I don't know... I haven't been on a tour bus. I just wouldn't go on the tour if that was part of it. It doesn't really matter to me who's driving.
Would you feel anxious if you were on a high bridge, but not moving, and someone else was with you?
I... I really don't know. I guess having someone sitting there with me wouldn't change anything. Like I keep saying, I just wouldn't put myself in that situation to begin with.
Would you feel anxious if you were on a high bridge, but not driving, such as being a passenger in a car that is parked on the bridge?
I feel like... we're just going in circles now. Like I've been saying, I wouldn't be in a parked car on a bridge either. I just wouldn't be there. I really don't know how else to answer this for you.
